# `packslip schema`

- **Usage:** `packslip schema [--releases] [--report]`

Print the JSON schema for a decoded release statement

--releases prints the release list's statement schema instead, and --report the schema of the report `verify --json` prints for a release. The statement schemas describe the in-toto payload, not the Sigstore bundle around it.

The three schemas, in that order, are published at https://packslip.dev/schema/release-v1.json, https://packslip.dev/schema/releases-v1.json, and https://packslip.dev/schema/verify-report-v1.json.

See https://packslip.dev/release/v1/#json-schemas

## Flags
- **`--releases`** — Print the releases/v1 release list schema instead of the release/v1 statement schema
- **`--report`** — Print the schema of the report `verify --json` prints for a release; wins over --releases
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
